rule: game-lines desk probability + passing desk verdict + DraftKings price, pre-game only
note: No pre-game alerts: an alert needs a game-lines-desk probability whose verdict passed (not NO EDGE / UNPROVEN) and a DraftKings price. NBA: 11 not pre-game; NHL: 15 not pre-game; WNBA: 1 not pre-game; MLS: 2 started or no start time; EPL: 1 not pre-game; UCL: 9 not pre-game; NFL: 11 desk verdict UNPROVEN; NCAAF: 15 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); NCAAB: 7 not pre-game; CWS: 1 not pre-game
